run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run an inference benchmark sweep across different GPU configurations using SLURM job scheduler
run_sweep_nodes_and_atoms: run a benchmark sweep over different GPU counts and atom counts with fixed or per-GPU scaling
run_load_config: load a Hydra YAML config file with optional key=value overrides and merge with JobConfig defaults
run_calculate_node_gpu_distribution: calculate the number of nodes and GPUs per node for a given total GPU count
run_generate_plots: generate weak scaling and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results
